project.description: Builds the speaker firmware and publishes GitLab release v<FW_VERSION> when the version in firmware/platformio.ini is new. Definition lives in the kotodama repo at jenkins/release-firmware.xml.

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
set -eu PROJECT=ninjalife%2Fkotodama API=https://gitlab.com/api/v4/projects/$PROJECT VERSION=$(sed -n 's/.*-DFW_VERSION="\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' firmware/platformio.ini) TAG="v$VERSION" [ -n "$VERSION" ] || { echo "FW_VERSION not found in firmware/platformio.ini"; exit 1; }
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --header "PRIVATE-TOKEN: $GITLAB_TOKEN" "$API/releases/$TAG") if [ "$code" = 200 ]; then echo "release $TAG already exists: nothing to do" exit 0 fi
echo "--- build firmware $VERSION" docker run --rm -v "$PWD/firmware":/fw -v kotodama-pio-cache:/root/.platformio -w /fw python:3.12-slim \ sh -c "pip install -q --root-user-action=ignore platformio && pio run -e kotodama-speaker; status=\$?; chown -R $(id -u):$(id -g) /fw/.pio; exit \$status" BIN=firmware/.pio/build/kotodama-speaker/firmware.bin grep -q "KOTODAMA-FW|$VERSION|" "$BIN" || { echo "built image doesn't carry version $VERSION"; exit 1; } cp "$BIN" "firmware-$VERSION.bin"
echo "--- upload to the package registry" URL="$API/packages/generic/kotodama-firmware/$VERSION/firmware.bin" curl -sSf --header "PRIVATE-TOKEN: $GITLAB_TOKEN" --upload-file "$BIN" "$URL" echo
echo "--- create release $TAG" printf '{"tag_name":"%s","ref":"%s","name":"Speaker firmware %s","description":"Kotodama speaker firmware %s, built by Jenkins from %s.","assets":{"links":[{"name":"firmware.bin","url":"%s","link_type":"package"}]}}' \ "$TAG" "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" "$VERSION" "$VERSION" "$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)" "$URL" > release.json curl -sSf --header "PRIVATE-TOKEN: $GITLAB_TOKEN" --header "Content-Type: application/json" \ --data @release.json "$API/releases" >/dev/null echo "released $TAG"
